items.title: Western Digital (WDC) Is Assessing New Iran Sanctions Exposure
items.summary: Western Digital (NasdaqGS:WDC) is assessing potential effects on its global operations following new U.S. sanctions targeting countries that trade with Iran, announced in August 2026. The measures focus on technology exports and financial dealings with Iran's trading partners, which could affect cross border supply chains and component sourcing.
